features.title: Elegant tufted backrest design
features.text: The beautifully tufted backrest brings a touch of sophistication, adding texture and depth while ensuring lasting comfort.

features.title: Easy to clean, effortless to love
features.text: With high ground clearance and easy-to-clean synthetic leather, maintaining a fresh, polished look has never been simpler.

features.title: Shape it your way every day
features.text: The modular design allows for flexible arrangements, adapting effortlessly to different room layouts and lifestyles.

features.title: Perfectly suited for small spaces
features.text: Compact and lightweight, this sofa is a great fit for apartments, bedrooms, or corners where you need extra seating.

features.title: Luxe feel built to last
features.text: Wrapped in breathable, durable upholstery, this sofa delivers a cool, comfortable seating experience—perfect for any climate.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
